scenarios.name: curt_title_drec
scenarios.subject: CURT draw records: mac_01 entry 0, titleret=240 returns to the title, cold det start with the drec switch (frames 360 to 540, step 60), no shots. The title draws the curtains (state_title_screen.c:250 set_curtain_scale(1.0f), curtains.c:251).
scenarios.proves: CURT: the draw records of the title frames are byte-equal between a base and a head build (curtains lists moved to the gfxin twin).
scenarios.reason: CURT: titleret as amb_title_arn02 (AMBTITLE), drec as kkj14_cgfx_drec (CGFX). Cap 40 s, deadline 35 s, until the drec line of frame 540.
